rationale: The evidence demonstrates that although the defect rate improved significantly and stabilized, the new rate (0.336%) remains strictly above the committed maximum (0.25%). The report correctly identifies this gap, halts the substantive advancement of project closure (STOP), properly restricts causal claims regarding the observational settings data, and accurately scopes its recommendations to maintaining the gains while continuing the improvement project. The analysis and reporting are highly professional and empirically rigorous.
